description: An elephant sits on his plump behind, with an innocent smile that's a joy to behold. This charming figurine does double duty as an artistic salt and pepper set, complete with a pair of glass salt & pepper shakers being held securely by this cute little pachyderm. Makes a great gift idea for any collector of African safari kitchen décor or anyone who could use a little extra luck. Three piece set includes one elephant statuette holder and two glass s & p shakers.
